title: La Cena
subtitle: Dinner
premise: Your last night in Madrid. You've found a small restaurant off the tourist trail. The menu is entirely in Spanish and you have a food allergy. Plus the waiter speaks no English and is very proud of that fact.
setting: A small, family-run restaurant in Lavapiés. Checkered tablecloths, framed photos of Real Madrid, the owner watching a match on a small TV behind the bar.

characters.name: Diego
characters.role: Waiter and co-owner, has worked here since he was 14
characters.personality: Playful, mildly dramatic, speaks only Spanish and is amused by your attempts

characters.name: Lucía
characters.role: Regular customer at the neighboring table, doctor
characters.personality: Quietly observant, offers to help once she sees you struggling, speaks careful Spanish when helping

arc: Studying the menu in panic → Diego arrives, amused → Attempting to explain your allergy → Lucía intervenes → Order successfully placed → A toast at the end, feel like you belong
